summary: web_fetch and media_fetch's Instagram-page guard moves into a new link-owner registry (design/social-per-network/30-link-owner-registry.md, PR 1), applied once by build_tool_specs instead of hand-wired in each tool.
details: The redirect now runs before everything else in media_fetch, including the question-identifier screen: pasting an Instagram page link together with a question that carries a phone number or ID now gets routed to instagram_read, where before it hit the identifier refusal first.
nora_egress_blocks_total no longer counts that one overlap case, since the identifier screen is never reached for it.
limitations: X and LinkedIn are not registered yet (PRs 2/3).
